answer: Producing a novel, coherent answer each epoch is cheap per alias but prohibitive across thousands, so scale buys less credibility — the attacker cannot simply buy a large, credible flock. The result is a self-purifying economy: every epoch, low-cost fake identities are filtered out by the same reputation mechanics that reward the honest ones.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a zephyr as the anchor of the cost. A umber stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a zenith...
